To find out how many days before the deadline Mike will finish his reading, we can follow these steps:

1. **Calculate the total number of days Mike needs to read the book:**
   Mike needs to read a 200-page book and plans to read 10 pages a day. 
   $$\text{Days needed} = \frac{\text{Total pages}}{\text{Pages per day}} = \frac{200}{10} = 20 \text{ days}$$

2. **Calculate how many days before the 30-day deadline he will finish:**
   The deadline is 30 days, and Mike will finish in 20 days.
   $$\text{Days before deadline} = 30 - 20 = 10 \text{ days}$$

Final answer: 10
